officialText:
(a) Firefighters' Emergency Operation shall apply to all nonautomatic elevators except where the hoistway or a portion thereof is not required to be fire-resistive construction (see Section 2.1.1.1), the rise does not exceed 2 000 mm (80 in.), and the hoistway does not penetrate a floor.

(b) Where Firefighters' Emergency Operation is provided voluntarily, the requirements of Section 2.27.4 shall also apply.

(c) The following signage shall be provided:

(1) A sign stating "Manual Elevator" shall be provided on the inside of the entrance frame of all nonautomatic operated elevators at the designated landing.

(2) Single nonautomatic elevators, or a group of non-automatic elevators, shall be provided with signage indicating "Manual Elevator" on or adjacent to the Phase I Firemans' Emergency Operation key switch located at the designated landing.

(3) Lettering shall be in accordance with Subsection 2.27.3.1.1(b).
